content.short: Our collection focuses on merging utility and fun together, by developing Vampire Playground - game that will utilise our Vampire Invasion NFTs and more!
content.description:
Vampire Invasion is a collection that started with 10k hand-drawn and unique NFTs, which depict vampire characters with different rarities based on over 200 assets. This drop pays homage to the Cardano NFT space by containing Easter Eggs from some of the most beloved projects.

But there is much more to it! These bloodthirsty vampires are also game characters, and their holders will be able to explore the fantasy realm of the Vampire Playground. Our ultimate goal is to establish partnerships with metaverse/game projects to keep things interesting for the players.
